title: doc comment names wrong type: &NoRevocationCheck vs actual NoRevocationCheck
description: cert.rs:26 says 'pass `&NoRevocationCheck` to skip' — this is already correct (NoRevocationCheck is the right struct). No issue here actually.
close_reason: doc comment correctly names NoRevocationCheck (the smime-tree type), not pkix_chain::NoRevocation. These are two different types; the comment is correct.
